name: Best-returner event study
description: Each year, the #1 and top 5 total returns inside the point-in-time S&P 500 at that year-end, and the return of those same stocks the next year.
notes: 35 removed tickers had no Yahoo/Stooq prints during a membership spell (often a recycled symbol, or a delisted name Yahoo no longer stores): ADCT, ADT, APC, AV, BBBY, BEAM, BTU, CAM, …
Stooq returned a browser check, so it filled no delisted names.
